name: email_draft
description: Write an email for the user: a writer model composes it from your one-line gist, it opens in Notepad, and the user is asked whether to send it. Pass who it is to (a name like Dad, or an address) and the gist of what to say (the user's own words are enough: 'late for dinner'). Do not write the email yourself. Ask the user only when the recipient or the point of the message is truly unknown.

to.description: a person's name as the user said it (Dad, Rohan) or an email address

gist.description: what the email should say, in one short line, from the user's words (e.g. 'I will be late for dinner')

subject.description: only if the user dictated an exact subject

body.description: only if the user dictated the exact text; otherwise leave empty so the writer composes it

send_draft.description: internal follow-up only, never set it

examples: email Dad that I'll be late for dinner
write an email to Rohan about Sunday lunch
send a mail to my professor asking for an extension
draft an email to hr@example.com about my leave
mail Mom that I reached home
